records.key: QT_QPA_FONTDIR={folder} is not a folder, so off-screen Qt has no fonts and draws all text in one fallback face.
records.source: QT_QPA_FONTDIR={folder} is not a folder, so off-screen Qt has no fonts and draws all text in one fallback face.
records.translation: QT_QPA_FONTDIR={folder} är ingen mapp, så skärmlös Qt har inga teckensnitt och ritar all text med ett enda reservteckensnitt.

records.key: QT_QPA_PLATFORM={platform}: on Windows, off-screen Qt has no fonts unless QT_QPA_FONTDIR names a font folder, so all text is drawn in one fallback face.
